result.instructions: Tools for Lob, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Lob data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run lob_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run lob_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run lob_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. lob_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: lob_verify_us_address
tools.title: Verify a US address
tools.description: Validate & standardize a US address, returning deliverability, corrected components, and a confidence score. Pass either a single freeform `address` string OR structured `primary_line`/`city`/`state`/`zip_code`. Non-mutating (no mail sent). Lob API: POST /v1/us_verifications.

address.description: Freeform single-line address (alternative to the structured fields).

primary_line.description: Primary delivery line, e.g. '210 King Street'.

tools.name: lob_verify_intl_address
tools.title: Verify an international address
tools.description: Validate & standardize a non-US address. `country` (2-letter ISO code) is required. Non-mutating (no mail sent). Lob API: POST /v1/intl_verifications.

tools.name: lob_us_zip_lookup

tools.name: lob_create_address
tools.title: Save an address record
tools.description: Create a reusable saved address record (does NOT send any mail). Returns an address id (adr_…) usable as `to`/`from` in mail tools. Lob API: POST /v1/addresses.

address_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Defaults to US.

tools.name: lob_create_postcard
tools.title: Send a postcard (COSTS MONEY)
tools.description: ⚠️ SENDS A REAL POSTCARD and charges your Lob account (use a test_ key to avoid real mail/charges). `to` and `from` accept an existing address id (adr_…) or an inline address object. `front`/`back` accept an HTML string, a hosted asset URL, or a template id (tmpl_…). Cancelable only before `send_date`. Lob API: POST /v1/postcards.

address_line1.description: Primary street address, e.g. '210 King St'.

address_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Defaults to US.

to.description: Either an existing address id (adr_…) or an inline address object.

from.description: Return address (id or inline object). Optional.

address_line1.description: Primary street address, e.g. '210 King St'.

address_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Defaults to US.

front.description: Front artwork: HTML string, asset URL, or template id (tmpl_…).

back.description: Back artwork: HTML string, asset URL, or template id (tmpl_…).

merge_variables.description: Key/value data merged into HTML templates.

send_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule the send (future). Cancelable until then.

tools.name: lob_create_letter
tools.title: Send a letter (COSTS MONEY)
tools.description: ⚠️ SENDS A REAL LETTER and charges your Lob account (use a test_ key to avoid real mail/charges). `to`/`from` accept an address id (adr_…) or inline object. `file` accepts an HTML string, a hosted PDF/URL, or a template id (tmpl_…). `color` is required. Cancelable only before `send_date`. Lob API: POST /v1/letters.

address_line1.description: Primary street address, e.g. '210 King St'.

address_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Defaults to US.

to.description: Either an existing address id (adr_…) or an inline address object.

address_line1.description: Primary street address, e.g. '210 King St'.

address_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code. Defaults to US.

from.description: Return address (id or inline object). Required for letters.

file.description: Letter body: HTML string, asset/PDF URL, or template id (tmpl_…).

color.description: true = color printing, false = black & white.

double_sided.description: Print on both sides. Default true.

address_placement.description: Where the recipient address is placed.

merge_variables.description: Key/value data merged into HTML templates.

send_date.description: ISO-8601 date/time to schedule the send (future). Cancelable until then.

tools.name: lob_cancel_postcard
tools.title: Cancel a scheduled postcard
tools.description: Cancel a postcard before its send_date so it is never mailed (and not billed). Fails if the send window has passed. Lob API: DELETE /v1/postcards/{id}.
